Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. United States government and the HTLVIII antibody test 2. United States republican representative William Dannemeyer withdraws from senate race 3. Wisconsin assembly defeats amendment 4. Gay and lesbian couples survey 5. Andy Humm speaks to New York City Council COMMERCIAL: Commodore Plus 4 6. Atlanta Gay Center protest 7. The New York City Gay Rights Bill, includes coverage of Mayor Koch, Andy Humm, Councilman Noah Dear, Harvey Firestein COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation 8. Barbara Streisand purchases play, "The Normal Heart," plans to adapt into film 9. Breast cancer more prevalent in childless women, health precautions 10. The American Foundation for AIDS Research begins fifteen more public services 11.Houston, Texas, first national hospital for AIDS treatment COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 12. Sports, interview with Ron Crispo 13. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Robert Isaacs, Psychotherapist, discusses drug addiction and AIDS 14. screening of "A Chance of a Lifetime" at Hunter College 15. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby, includes clip COMMERCIAL: CASIO Pocket TV 2. Sybil Bruncheon opens more presents and intros the monster COMMERCIAL: The Monster 3. Sybil attempts to cook with Joseph Viane COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation 4. Sybil returns 5. Current events/media/culture, includes clip 6. Robert Reilly, Author of the God of Mirrors, discusses his book
